senses.gloss: , a mnemonical sign for תָּ֗דִיר (constant, daily), חוֹבָֹה (obligatory), שַֹׁבָּת (suspending the Sabbath), and ט̇וּמְאָה (disregard of levitical uncleanness).
units: <cite ref="Menachot 51a:6">Men. 51ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. written out in full, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Ar. <cite ref="V00042"><he>תבט״ש</he></cite>, v. Rashi); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 486">Yalk. Lev. 486</cite> <cite ref="V00560"><he>תכשיט</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
